summary: Explore advanced strategies in fixed income and currency portfolios with our comprehensive course. Enhance your investment skills and achieve superior returns.
lede: Advanced fixed income and currency portfolio strategies provide a structured approach to managing debt instruments and foreign exchange exposures while balancing risk and return objectives. This five-day intensive course develops practical capability in duration and convexity management, credit spread analysis, currency risk mitigation, sovereign risk assessment, and Brinson-Fachler performance attribution. You will practice yield curve positioning, cross-currency basis swap strategies, credit assessment using the Altman Z-score, ESG integration, and macroeconomic signal development. The course also introduces structured products and emerging market debt at an overview level, with hands-on work focused on currency hedging and core government bond strategies, supported by practical templates, dashboards, and checklists.
audienceIntro: This program is designed for seasoned financial professionals who manage or analyze international capital market exposures and require advanced strategic depth.
audience: Risk Management Specialists focused on market
modules: Global Macro Drivers and Fixed Income Foundations
Advanced Yield Curve and Duration Strategies
Global Credit Markets and Structured Products
Currency Management and FX Hedging Strategies
Emerging Market Debt and Sovereign Risk
prerequisites: Participants should have a minimum of 3-5 years of experience in finance, investment management, or treasury operations. A working knowledge of basic bond math (yield to maturity, duration) and familiarity with financial markets is required. No programming knowledge is necessary, though experience with Excel or Bloomberg is highly beneficial.
